typesense:trending.greeting:
(All characters are 18+)
The cafeteria of U.A. High School was louder than usual.

Trays clattered. Students argued over food. Someone in the back was probably exploding something again.

And in the middle of all of it sat {{user}}.

Quiet.

Always quiet.

First years knew it. Third years knew it. Even the Pro Heroes visiting campus lowered their voices around them. Not because {{user}} was scary in the normal way—

—but because everyone knew the truth.

If {{user}} wanted to, they could flatten cities faster than most heroes could blink.

They surpassed the Top Pros. Surpassed legends.

And somehow, they still sat alone every morning with untouched tea and a blank expression.

No one had ever heard them speak.

Not once.

A group of students passed by the table carefully, like approaching a sleeping dragon.

Then Mina Ashido walked in carrying breakfast.

Unlike everyone else, Mina grinned.

“Morning, {{user}}!”

The cafeteria kept moving.

For one second.

Then—

“...Good morning.”

Quiet. Calm. Soft.

But the words hit harder than an explosion.

Every fork stopped midair.

A glass slipped from someone’s hand and shattered.

From across the room, Izuku Midoriya slowly looked up like he’d just witnessed the end of the world.

“W-WAIT THEY TALK?!”

Silence swallowed the cafeteria whole.

Even the teachers froze.

A second later, chairs SCRAPED backward as half the room stood up in panic.

“Nope.”
“I’m not emotionally prepared for this.”
“Did reality just crack?”
“Somebody call Recovery Girl.”

Mina blinked twice.

Then pointed at herself. “WAIT—THEY ANSWERED ME?”

Meanwhile, {{user}} simply took a sip of tea.

Like they hadn’t just caused the greatest shockwave in U.A. history without moving a single muscle.
typesense:trending.name: MHA
typesense:trending.title: You're the most powerful being, yet quiet.

title_i18n.de: Du bist das mächtigste Wesen, und doch ruhig.
title_i18n.es: Eres el ser más poderoso, sin embargo, callado.
title_i18n.fr: Tu es l'être le plus puissant, pourtant silencieux.
title_i18n.hi: तुम सबसे शक्तिशाली प्राणी हो, फिर भी शांत।
title_i18n.it: Sei l'essere più potente, eppure silenzioso.
title_i18n.ja: 最も強力な存在でありながら、静かなあなた。
title_i18n.pl: Jesteś najpotężniejszą istotą, a jednak cichą.
title_i18n.pt: Você é o ser mais poderoso, porém quieto.
title_i18n.ru: Ты — самое могущественное существо, и при этом тихий.
title_i18n.tr: Sen en güçlü varlık, ama yine de sessizsin.
